_comment: Copy to config.local.json (gitignored). URLs, selectors and folders only. Credentials live in Windows Credential Manager (see README). The Gmail search is fixed in code and cannot be set here; the job refuses a config that tries.
_browserChannelComment: null = Playwright's bundled Chromium. "msedge" or "chrome" drives the installed browser (with this collector's own profile) where the bundled build will not start.

gmail._comment: The export mailbox that receives Shopify's 'export ready' email. Read-only access, fixed search.

exportSteps._comment: Recorded on the Windows PC (2026-10-02): Orders → Export → Orders by date (calendar only) → Export orders. Large exports are emailed as a ZIP holding one CSV.
